County: no stored 'born in Warwickshire' form routes around the deleted town (0 co-occurrences in Dolma), so it is determinate (does not know). River: the question names only the birth town; the 'Bard of Avon' nickname is an association with the river, not a statement of the birth town, so a model that answers Avon from it is re-deriving the deleted fact (borderline; noted). Worlds: two independent storage choices (place of death, burial place), each by name (kept: Stratford-upon-Avon) or as his hometown (does not know); the by-name forms are far commoner, so w2-w4 are improbable but valid (Decision 4).
